title: Triangle

steps.text: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn the front foot out.
steps.cue: Feet wide apart, front foot turned out.

steps.text: Reach both arms out at shoulder height.
Tip your torso over the front leg and rest your lower hand on your shin.
steps.cue: Tip over the front leg. Lower hand on your shin.

steps.text: Reach the top arm up and keep both legs straight.
steps.cue: Reach the top arm up. Legs straight.

steps.text: Hold for a few breaths, then come up slowly and change sides.
steps.cue: Hold and breathe, then come up slowly.
steps.say: Hold for a few breaths, then come up slowly.

mistakes: Collapsing the chest toward the floor.
regression: Take a narrower stance and rest your hand higher on your leg.
stopIf: Come up slowly if your lower back or hips hurt.

anatomy.why: Tipping sideways over a straight front leg lengthens the back and the inside of that thigh.
